$comment: Single source of truth for TheFreeForeverFitnessApp. ADR-0013 (blueprint, dark-first), ADR-0021 (no raw literals). Edit here only; dist/tokens.css, dist/tokens.ts and dist/theme.css are generated by scripts/build-tokens.mjs and must never be hand-edited.

hairline.use: Non-semantic rule between list rows. Never the only boundary of an interactive control - WCAG 1.4.11 exempt as decorative.

line-strong.use: Boundary of an interactive control: field border, unchecked box, plate outline. Must stay >= 3:1 on every surface.

fg-primary.use: The number you are reading mid-set.

fg-muted.use: Placeholder, ghost values, timestamps. Still real body text - held to 4.5:1.

accent.use: The single safety-orange signal. Primary action, focus, current set.

info.use: Neutral informational state. Always paired with a glyph.

success.use: Completed set, target met. Always paired with a glyph.

attention.use: Needs a look, not an error. Always paired with a glyph.

danger.use: Destructive action or failed state. Always paired with a glyph.

on-accent.use: Label drawn on an accent fill.

on-info.use: Label drawn on an info fill.

on-success.use: Label drawn on a success fill.

on-attention.use: Label drawn on an attention fill.

on-danger.use: Label drawn on a danger fill.

focus-ring.use: Outer focus ring. Contrasts with the page.

focus-ring-inner.use: Inner focus ring. Contrasts with the control's own fill, so the ring survives on an accent button.

overlay.use: Scrim behind a sheet or dialog. Translucent by design and purely a dimming layer; the dialog it backs owns all of the contrast.

skeleton-base.use: Loading placeholder fill. Carries no information: a skeleton is a shape, and the content it stands in for is announced to assistive technology as busy.

skeleton-sheen.use: Loading placeholder sweep. Carries no information and is not rendered at all under prefers-reduced-motion.

contrast.$comment: Drives test/contrast.test.ts. 'text' roles are asserted at 4.5:1 against every 'surface' role in both themes; 'ui' roles at 3:1; 'decorative' roles are exempt and each carries a written justification in 'use'. 'pairs' covers foreground-on-fill combinations that are not surface-relative.

pairs.why: Inner focus ring must stay visible on a primary button.
Inner focus ring must stay visible on a danger button.
Entered value inside a NumberField well.
Ghost/placeholder value inside a NumberField well - the tightest pair in the system.

hairline.use: Default rule and control border. Public vocabulary: feature teams need a hairline width, and a fallback literal in feature CSS defeats ADR-0021.

strong.use: Emphasised boundary: invalid field, selected tab underline, checkbox and radio outline.

compact.use: Platform floor. Only for controls outside the workout flow.

mid-set.use: Anything tapped mid-set, one-handed, out of breath. The 'xl' size.

standard.use: The only easing curve in the system.

display-xl.use: The rest timer. One number per glance.

sans.value: "FF Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
sans.use: Everything. Self-hosted, subset to latin, variable (ADR-0014).

numeric.value: "FF Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
numeric.use: Numerals. Same face; tabular figures come from font-variant-numeric on :root.

plate.$comment: IWF calibrated plate colours. ADR-0013 carves these out of the blueprint palette deliberately: this is the language already printed on the equipment, and it is identical in both themes because a 20kg plate is blue in a dark gym too. Every plate is rendered with a line-strong outline, because white5 and grey1p25 do not separate from a light surface on their own. Colour is never the only signal - the mass is always printed on the slab.
